edges.text: Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod; pre=True becomes mode='before', each_item=True becomes validating the list items in the function, always=True becomes validate_default=True on the Field.
Move the check into an Annotated type with AfterValidator / BeforeValidator.
Import BaseSettings from pydantic_settings instead of pydantic and keep the class otherwise unchanged.
Import BaseSettings from pydantic_settings and replace the inner class Config with model_config = SettingsConfigDict(...), keeping env_prefix and other settings.

Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod; pre=True becomes mode='before', each_item=True becomes validating the list items in the function, always=True becomes validate_default=True on the Field.
Move the check into an Annotated type with AfterValidator / BeforeValidator.
Replace Model.__fields__ with Model.model_fields; field.required becomes field.is_required(), outer_type_ becomes annotation.
Replace .dict(...) with .model_dump(...), keeping the same keyword arguments.
Replace .dict() with dict(obj) and filter keys by hand.

In `validate_namespaces`, return the literal `"*"` unchanged before lowercasing list values. The current list comprehension iterates a string wildcard and turns it into `["*"]`, so downstream code no longer recognizes the all-namespaces sentinel.

In `__list_hpa_v1`, replace `async for hpa in res` with ordinary iteration (`for hpa in res`) when building the returned dictionary: `_list_namespaced_or_global_objects` resolves to a list, not an async iterable.

In `validate_resources`, return `"*"` unchanged before iterating over `v` (and keep the existing empty-list handling). Otherwise a CLI wildcard is iterated into `["*"]`, so resource discovery treats it as a literal resource name and finds nothing.

In `__list_hpa_v1`, remove the `run_in_executor` wrapper around `_list_namespaced_or_global_objects` and directly await that async method. It already offloads the Kubernetes requests internally; running the coroutine in an executor returns an unawaited coroutine instead of the HPA list.
Replace .json(...) with .model_dump_json(...), keeping by_alias and other keyword arguments.
Replace .json() with json.dumps(obj.model_dump(mode='json')).

+def _validate_prometheus_url(v: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:

+def _validate_namespaces(v: Union[list[str], Literal["*"]]) -> Union[list[str], Literal["*"]]:
